questions.question: Define meta tag.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Answer: A meta tag is an HTML element that provides information about a webpage to
  • search engines and browsers. It helps describe the page's content and supports search engine
  • optimization (SEO).It is placed inside the section of an HTML document.
  • Title tag: Specifies the title of a webpage.Meta description: Provides a brief summary of the
  • webpage.
  • E-commerce review platforms: Amazon, Flipkart – Customer ratings and reviews help
  • buyers evaluate product quality and make purchasing decisions.
  • Crawling: Discovering web pages using bots.
  • Improves Search Engine Rankings
  • Protection of Personal Information: Privacy practices help prevent misuse of customer
  • details such as names, email addresses and phone numbers.
questions.final_answer: details such as names, email addresses and phone numbers

questions.question: Differentiate User generated content with Brand created content.
questions.solution_html:

  • opinions and reviews. Example: A customer posting a product review.
  • Brand-Created Content :Created by the company or brand. Communicates the brand's message

questions.question: Define social media and state its role in digital marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Social media refers to online platforms that allow users to create, share and exchange
  • information, ideas and content.Examples: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.
  • Role in Digital Marketing: Social media helps businesses promote products, increase brand
  • awareness, engage customers, generate leads and drive website traffic.
  • Mark Distribution: Definition – (1 mark); Examples – (1 mark); Role – (1 mark).
  • Inverted Index: Mapping words to the pages containing them.
questions.final_answer: Inverted Index: Mapping words to the pages containing them

questions.question: Explain indexing in detail.
questions.solution_html:

  • Example: Google analyzes a new blog post and adds it to its index if eligible.
  • Mark Distribution: Definition – (1 mark); any four steps with explanation – (4 marks).

questions.question: Differentiate digital marketing from tradition marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Digital Marketing :Uses websites, search engines, email and social media. Allows quick
  • interaction through messages and comments. Targets specific audiences. Campaigns can be
  • changed quickly at lower cost.
  • Traditional Marketing :Uses newspapers, TV, radio and posters. Reaches a broad audience.
  • Measures results using surveys and audience estimates. Changes may take more time and money.
  • Example: Instagram advertising is digital marketing, whereas newspaper advertising is
  • traditional marketing.(Mark Distribution: Any five valid differences – (1 mark) each ((5 marks)).)
questions.final_answer: traditional marketing.(Mark Distribution: Any five valid differences – each ().)
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain the critical role of web analytics in digital marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Web analytics is the process of collecting, measuring, analyzing and reporting website
  • data to understand user behavior and improve digital marketing performance.
  • Role of Web Analytics:Website Traffic Analysis, Understanding User Behavior, Conversion
  • Tracking,Campaign Performance Measurement,Decision Making and Optimization
  • Example: Google Analytics can help an online store identify which marketing channels generate
  • the most purchases.
questions.final_answer: the most purchases
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Explain why privacy, security and trust are becoming important in digital / marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Privacy, security and trust are essential in digital marketing because businesses collect
  • and process customer information through websites, applications and online transactions.
questions.final_answer: Answer: Privacy, security and trust are essential in digital marketing because businesses collect

questions.question: Write the advantages and limitations of influencer marketing for / businesses.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Influencer marketing is a digital marketing strategy in which businesses collaborate
  • with social media influencers to promote products or services to their followers.
  • Advantages
  • Increases Brand Awareness,Builds Credibility: Reaches Target Audiences
  • Limitations
  • High Cost: Risk of Fake Followers and Engagement, Artificial engagement can reduce
  • campaign effectiveness.Reputation Risk: Controversial influencer behavior or misleading
  • promotions may negatively affect the brand.
  • Example: A cosmetics company collaborating with a beauty influencer on Instagram to promote
  • a new skincare product.
questions.final_answer: a new skincare product
